'''Jez''' was the nickname of a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served in [[Aiwha-3 Squad]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Trained by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kal Skirata]], the [[Squad/Legends|unit]] first saw action in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], in which all members except Jez were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] afterward, Jez took part in a standoff on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after a rogue group of elite [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s gained control of the [[Arca Company Barracks]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] survived the Clone Wars and later served as part of the Republic's forces that were reorganized into the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Biography==
"Jez" was the nickname of a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. He was a member of [[Aiwha-3 Squad]], a [[Squad/Legends|unit]] of elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]]. Jez and the other squad members were trained by [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]] to serve in the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Triple Zero" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Jez and his squad saw action in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="Triple Zero" /> Fighting against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], all members of Aiwha-3 Squad except Jez were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Triple Zero" /><ref name="CSWE" />

Five [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the Battle of Geonosis, Jez was redeployed to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he took part in a standoff at the [[Arca Company Barracks]] after six rogue [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]]s&mdash;an elite cadre of [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]&mdash;took control of the complex. However, Skirata, Jez's old [[Cuy'val Dar|training sergeant]], was able to neutralize the situation without violence and even had [[Time/Legends|time]] to share a few words with Jez during the incident.<ref name="Triple Zero" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the Clone Wars ended, and the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|transformed]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Jez came to serve in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Roly Melusar]] and, along with many other clone [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], took part in a briefing held by Melusar concerning measures against [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users.<ref name="501st" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|They call us Balawai, don't they? Anyone who isn't Korunnai is a downlander, and they don't think much of them.|Jez, on the Korunnai|<ref name="501st" />}}
A clone of the Mandalorian [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="Triple Zero" /> Jez stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="SWE" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> He had a sense of humor and joked about his job as a commando even after losing three of his fellow squad members just days before on Geonosis. Jez was also delighted to meet Kal Skirata, his old training sergeant, on Coruscant.<ref name="Triple Zero" /> He possessed knowledge of the planet [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] and its inhabitants, being able to tell the difference between the native [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] and [[Balawai]] groups.<ref name="501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jez first appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', a [[2006]] novel written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="Triple Zero" />
